title: Theorem
body_md: \label{Th7-1} Let $f=h+\overline g\in \mathscr{P}_{\mathcal{H}_n^0}(\alpha)$ with $0\leq \alpha<1$ and be given by \emph{(\ref{Eq 1.7})}. Then for each $q \geq 2$, $S_{1,q}(f)\in \mathscr{P}_{\mathcal{H}_n^0}(\alpha)$ for $\|z\|_{\infty}< \frac{1}{2n^2}$.
